name: s81lk_kp4_ddly-t2-COMMIT
purpose: S81 link KP4 decoder tile ddly (received-word SRAM delay) of the 4-tile cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec, 10-17. Bench = cluster equivalence vs 33a35eb7d and the one-short word-seam mutant.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_kp4_ddly u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_common.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_link/ot_s81_kp4_ddly.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_ddly/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_ddly/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81lk_kp4_ddly --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_kp4_ddly --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w2c_64x546_m1 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-TILES2 10-17: four-tile re-split of the KP4 decoder cluster ot_s81_kp4_dec (replaces s81lk_kp4_deca / decb, REJECTED at their CTS gates: 259.2 um tiles, SRAM in the middle, clock on the S face; TT insertion 307-455 / 295-417 ps, spread 148 / 122 ps).  Cluster 2 x 2: dsyn SW (PMA in W), ddly NW, dchn SE, dout NE (beats out E); every seam registered at both pins.  Bit-exact vs the 33a35eb7d two-tile decoder on every output and cycle (tb_s81_kp4_eq: RTL same cycle, hardware view with all tile pin registers = reference + 2 cycles; mutants DMUT 2 / 3 and a one-short word seam FAIL).  ddly: the 64 x 546 received-word SRAM delay (DD = 55, free-running pointer) alone; macro at (43.2, 43.2) MY on the 43.2 lattice against the N face (20.5 um channel), one std-cell band S (41 um) holding every register (all pins on the S face: gate 1 with r_d on the E face and clk at the W end measured 1,097 sinks TT 208-310 ps, spread 102 -- a register L around the macro); MY puts the read port and half the write port on the macro's E edge above the r_d pins.  S face: w_d W half (from dsyn), clk / rst_n centre, r_d E half (to dout), 4.6/um.  ~1.1k sinks.  Aspect 1.69 is the macro's (178.6 x 81) plus the 20 um channels; a single-macro delay tile. S81-TILES3 10-17 PARENT PITCH (coordinator 0co: 2x2 parent with aligned pitch, no gaps on link paths): hard children sit on the 43.2-um child lattice with >= 20-um channels, so every seam tile edge is a lattice multiple minus 21.6 um. ddly 248.4 -> 237.6 wide (5.5 x 43.2): 248.4 = 5.75 lattice left a 54-um channel to dout; now 21.6. Macro centred at x 29.376 MY (>= 27 um from W/E core edges), band S unchanged; w_d 4.32-118.8 (= dsyn x_q), r_d 127.44-233.28 (5.1/um), clk/rst_n unchanged. RTL unchanged.
